office.collabora.title: Collabora Online
office.collabora.help: Open and edit files of the media library in Collabora Online. Users who may edit edit there; users who may only download see the file read-only. Changes are saved as a new version.
office.collabora.url_help: Address of the office server, e.g. https://office.example.com. The server must reach the wiki at its public address (server.base_url).
office.collabora.verify_proof: Verify the signature of every request (proof key, recommended)
office.collabora.verify_proof_help: The wiki only accepts requests signed by the office server.
office.collabora.readonly: Users without the right to download may view the file there read-only
office.collabora.readonly_help: Download, print, export and copy are switched off. Otherwise they see the file in the browser only.
office.collabora.test_ok: Connected: {view} file types to view, {edit} to edit
office.collabora.proof_missing: The server publishes no proof key: switch the check off or update the server.
office.collabora.default_hint: Choose the program as default viewer in the general settings (media).
